import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

plan_path = Path('results/expansion/baseline_priority_plan.json')
raw = Path('results/expansion/raw/dice/meta_llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct__text-only_.jsonl')
initial = raw.read_bytes()
commands = [['bash', 'scripts/with_resource.sh', 'nim', '.venv/bin/python', '-u',
             'scripts/expand_nim.py', '--models', model, '--protocol-file', filename]
            for model, filename in [('openai/gpt-oss-20b', 'protocol-gpt-priority.json'),
                                     ('meta/llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct', 'protocol-llama90-resume.json')]]
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'finish the original API baselines before the slower additional Llama-90B cohort'}, 'NIM immutable deployment revision not exposed'),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'status': 'waiting_for_next_complete_llama90_episode',
          'commands': commands, 'llama90_initial_episodes': initial.count(b'\n'),
          'llama90_initial_prefix_bytes': len(initial), 'llama90_initial_prefix_sha256': file_sha256(raw),
          'availability_evidence': 'results/expansion/protocol-additional.json',
          'reason': 'Validation availability probe needs 126.76465725898743 seconds for 304 stopped output tokens. Preserve this responsive but slow cohort and prioritize the missing GPT/Bolt baseline episodes; then resume Llama-90B exactly. No performance score selects this schedule.',
          'controls': 'All prompts, decoder settings, seed ranges, requested 200/game cohorts and existing cached responses stay fixed. Shared NIM mutex and concurrency one for every batch.'}
plan_path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')


def save():
    plan_path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')


while True:
    process = subprocess.run(['ps', '-p', '35211', '-o', 'command='], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if 'runs/nim_additional_followup.py' not in process.stdout:
        record['old_supervisor_already_gone'] = True
        break
    if raw.stat().st_size > len(initial):
        data = raw.read_bytes()
        if data.endswith(b'\n') and data.count(b'\n') > initial.count(b'\n'):
            assert os.getpgid(35211) == 35211
            os.killpg(35211, signal.SIGTERM)
            record.update(paused_llama90_episodes=data.count(b'\n'), paused_raw_bytes=len(data),
                          paused_raw_sha256=file_sha256(raw), termination_signal='SIGTERM')
            break
    time.sleep(.1)
assert raw.read_bytes().startswith(initial)
record['status'] = 'acquiring_slot_for_gpt_priority'
save()
gpt_raw = Path('results/expansion/raw/cards/openai_gpt-oss-20b.jsonl')
gpt_prefix = gpt_raw.read_bytes()
gpt = subprocess.Popen(commands[0])
# Other waiting follow-ups are released only after GPT acquires its slot.
while gpt.poll() is None:
    owners = [p.read_text() for p in (Path.home() / '.cache').glob('nim-slot-*/owner')]
    if any(f'pid={gpt.pid} ' in owner for owner in owners):
        break
    time.sleep(.2)
old_path = Path('results/expansion/additional_followup_plan.json')
old = json.loads(old_path.read_text())
old.update(status='finished', outcome='interrupted_and_requeued_for_baseline_priority',
           replacement_plan=str(plan_path), pending_gpt_command_moved_to=commands[0],
           llama90_resume_command=commands[1],
           limitation='Supervisor terminated after a completed episode; the full additional cohort and original queued GPT command did not finish here. Preserved cache/raw data are resumed by the replacement plan.')
old_path.write_text(json.dumps(old, indent=2) + '\n')
record['status'] = 'running_gpt_priority'
save()
code = gpt.wait()
assert gpt_raw.read_bytes().startswith(gpt_prefix)
record.update(gpt_exit_code=code, gpt_existing_prefix_preserved=True,
              status='waiting_for_bolt_llama11_and_mistral_followups')
save()
for name in ('intermittent_resume_plan.json', 'mistral_default_plan.json'):
    while json.loads((Path('results/expansion') / name).read_text())['status'] != 'finished':
        time.sleep(10)
record['status'] = 'acquiring_slot_then_resuming_llama90'
save()
result = subprocess.run(commands[1])
assert raw.read_bytes().startswith(initial)
record.update(status='finished', llama90_exit_code=result.returncode, llama90_initial_prefix_preserved=True)
save()
